profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer in Test at NextGear Capital
profile.summary:
I have a strong passion for development and intelligible software. While working on several testing projects professionally and academically, both desktop and mobile, I fell in love with test automation. I realize the demand for easily maintainable, scalable, and continuously iterated automation frameworks.

I find it both challenging and rewarding to engineer reusable test suites and custom tools to help drive a product forward. Test engineering is less about quality assurance and more about assisting development in receiving as much test feedback as possible utilizing leading tools and technologies, thus empowering them to enhance quality. I enjoying utilizing multiple open source projects to achieve this goal and am eager to utilize new, emerging tools to fuel the future of test engineering.

positions.title: Test Automation Consultant
positions.description: Creating suites and giving clients insight into best practices of automated web testing while utilizing page object design methods, loadable components, flexible data classes, cloud parallelization, continuous integration, and designing a suite independent of the operating system being tested on.

positions.title: Senior QA Analyst
positions.description: I managed the day-to-day QA operations including test management, mobile and web testing efforts, automation testing projects, and overall team effectiveness.

positions.title: Automation Test Engineer
positions.description: I used the automation tool HP Quicktest Professional to test the Cummins Insite application for several years and was my focus. I also managed test cases and used IBM Rational ClearQuest to track bugs.

positions.title: 46R - Broadcast Journalist
positions.description: I was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom partially with the 4th Infantry Division and  then the 82nd Airborne Division.

projects.title: IRIS v3.0.x (iOS)
projects.description:
This Cook Medical iOS app connects cook employees to individuals from various hospitals, clinics. etc. Users can create connections to other users, view detailed information about people and facilities, view global connection details from within feeds.

Along with testing this application against various Apple devices, I assisted Cook in moving difficult-to-collaborate static test documents into the TestRail test management server. This allows a centralized depot of test suites for any project to be accessible to all teams members and create project test runs as needed while collaborating the results.

projects.title: ChaCha v5.0/5.1/5.2 (iOS)
projects.description:
Ask any question on your mind and get real-time answers from automated sources, ChaCha guides, or other app users worldwide. Explore live question feeds associated with your favorite topics. Have conversations with another user who answered your question. You can even view questions and answers from users around your current GPS location.

The new, slightly redesigned ChaCha.com experience with the same back-end system the mobile app utilizes bridges the gap between both products and allows users of each to interact with each other.
